selections.rationale: Figure 9 is the clearest input-route figure: it is a two-stage architecture diagram showing scRNA-seq gene tokens entering scLLM/Q-former on the cell side and text token sequences entering the text LLM on the language side, then passing through the cross-modal discriminative and generative interfaces. That directly matches the model-visible carriers and transformation chains for both cell and text inputs, unlike the result plots and dataset summaries.
